original_description: Bring your Clout creative workspace into the conversation. Create realistic images, build a consistent AI influencer, turn your products into UGC and marketing content, generate videos and lip sync, or plan faceless stories and cinematic sequences. Explore available models and templates, reuse saved characters and product references, review your creative plans, and follow generation progress until your results are ready. Connect your Clout workspace with OAuth to access your own assets and creative tools.
